h2. Description

On a work order page, *the Lead Technician list offers only the first 100 people*, so a technician who can lead work at the location but whose name sorts later *cannot be chosen as lead from the work order page*.

For example,
* a location has more than 100 people who can appear in the Lead Technician list
* the list, scrolled to its end, stops after the 100th name (alphabetically), then shows the current lead
* typing a later technician's name into the field does not find them
* the same technician IS offered in the board's *Reassign lead technician* dialog

This appears inconsistent with the lead changes defined in *Epic SV-10043* (Story *SV-10047*), which the test cases below expect to be made from the work order page.

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin and check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*.
# Open any Approved work order (e.g. *Work Orders* > *All* > search {{ZZAUTOTEST F3 Reassign Bottom}} > *S2-36155*).
# On the card at the left, click *Lead Technician* and scroll the list to the end.
#* The list ends with *QA Foreman*, then the current lead (101 entries: *Unassigned*, 100 people from *Aaron …* to the *Q* names, then the current lead).
#* *Ralph Edwards* and *ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo* are not in it.
# Type {{Ralph Edwards}} (or {{Ben Bravo}}) into the Lead Technician field.
#* The list does not change; nobody new is offered.
# Go to *Work Orders* > *All* > *Board View*, open any card's *…* menu > *Reassign lead technician* and type {{Ral}} in its search box.
#* *Ralph Edwards* is offered (58 open).

*Actual Result:*
* The work order page offers only the first 100 people as lead; *Ralph Edwards* and *ZZAUTOTEST Ben Bravo* cannot be chosen there.
* The same people are offered as lead in the *Reassign lead technician* dialog.

*Expected Result:*
* A technician who can lead work at the location can be chosen as lead on the work order page, as the test cases expect: *"Step 6: Lead Technician reads "Ralph Edwards" and Mileage reads 120,500."* and *"Step 4: Lead Technician is Ben Bravo."*
